## 🔁 ReliabilityAgent: Self-Observing AI
**The AI agent that diagnoses incidents, remediates them, AND verifies its own work via Dynatrace.**
**Architecture:** Google ADK + Gemini 2.5 Pro | **Telemetry:** OTel SDK → Dynatrace Grail | **Differentiator:** Recursive self-observability loop (queries own traces to ensure thoroughness).

1.title: Total Incidents Handled
1.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.name == "agent.incident.handle"
| summarize count()

2.title: Self-Check Verdicts

3.title: Self-Check Reinvestigation Rate
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.name == "agent.phase.self_check"
| summarize count(), by: trigger = span.attributes["self_check.retry_triggered"]

4.title: Investigation Verdicts
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.name == "agent.phase.self_check"
| summarize count(), by: verdict = span.attributes["self_check.verdict"]

5.title: LLM Token Cost Over Time
5.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.name == "agent.incident.handle"
| filter isNotNull(span.attributes["llm.cost.usd"])
| summarize cost = sum(toDouble(span.attributes["llm.cost.usd"])), by: bin(timestamp, 5m)

6.title: Agent Investigation Phases Duration
6.query:
fetch spans
| filter startsWith(span.name, "agent.phase.")
| summarize avgDuration = avg(duration), by: phase = span.name

7.title: Recent Incidents & Self-Check Status
7.query:
fetch spans
| filter span.name == "agent.incident.handle"
| fields timestamp, IncidentID = span.attributes["incident.id"], Severity = span.attributes["incident.severity"], Model = span.attributes["llm.model"], TotalCost = span.attributes["llm.cost.usd"], InputTokens = span.attributes["llm.tokens.input"], OutputTokens = span.attributes["llm.tokens.output"]
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 20
